title: Miband 4 - Feature Request: More Alarm Features
symptom: The issue requests more alarm features for the Mi Band 4, including forwarding all alarms to the watch, muting alarms without touching the phone, and adding more detail to notification text. A commenter also requests showing elapsed time since scan on the Mi Band 5.
fix: The issue was closed as solved in a build available at https://bigdigital.home.blog, but no specific fix details are given.
evidence_quote: I'll close this issue because it is solved in the build available at https://bigdigital.home.blog.
